name: Pilgrim Lodge
description_short: United Church of Christ overnight camp on Lake Cobbosseecontee in West Gardiner, Maine. Youth sessions run mostly a week long, for campers from the early elementary grades through new high school graduates.
special_needs_notes: Most of the wooded site is linked by paths, ramps and a boardwalk, and a golf cart helps with harder to reach areas; two cabins have ramps and accessible showers. The waterfront is hard to reach for people needing mobility help. Campers who need extra one on one support attend with an aide, such as a parent.

sessions.name: Camp Pride (grades 7 to 12 and new graduates)
Middler + Senior Adventures (grades 7 to 12 and new graduates)
Senior High (grades 10 to 12 and new graduates)
Justice Together (grades 9 to 12 and new graduates)

Researched by Claude from this page. Full week youth session fee is $825, $675 or $580; families choose a tier and all get the same camp. The Pathfinders half week page lists $410, $330 or $285.
Researched by Claude from this page. Church scholarships, Maine Conference scholarships, Pride scholarships, and bring a friend and multiple week discounts.
Researched by Claude from this page. Parents handle transportation; check in usually 2 to 4 pm on the first day, pickup 9:30 am on the last day.
